import Mathlib.Algebra.MonoidAlgebra.Degree
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Eval
import Mathlib.Order.ConditionallyCompleteLattice.Finset
import Mathlib.Basic.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Data.Finsupp.Weight
import Mathlib.RingTheory.MvPowerSeries.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.Tactic
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.RingDivision
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.NoZeroDivisors
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.FreeModule.PID

#check_failure Roth.det_hasseDeriv_separated
namespace Det169Abstract
variable {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι]
#check @Matrix.det_mul
#check @Matrix.det_transpose
#check @AlgHom.map_det
theorem generic (A B : Matrix ι ι R) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ ∑ k, A i k * B j k).det = A.det * B.det := by
  simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using
    (Matrix.det_mul A B.transpose).trans
      (congrArg (fun b ↦ A.det * b) (Matrix.det_transpose B))
#print axioms generic
example (A B : Matrix (Fin 0) (Fin 0) R) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ ∑ k, A i k * B j k).det = A.det * B.det := generic A B
example (A B : Matrix (Fin 2) (Fin 2) (ZMod 1)) :
    (Matrix.of fun i j ↦ ∑ k, A i k * B j k).det = A.det * B.det := generic A B
end Det169Abstract
